product.name: Aurelio LuminaDesk 60W
product.description: Designed for modern workspaces, the Aurelio LuminaDesk 60W delivers focused illumination while keeping the desk area uncluttered. Its adjustable aluminum arm allows users to direct light precisely onto a monitor or writing surface, reducing eye strain during long sessions. The lamp features a 60‑W LED module that maintains a consistent brightness of 800 lumens, powered either through a USB‑C port or a standard AC adapter. A built‑in dimming slider offers three intensity levels, and an integrated USB hub provides convenient charging for a phone or tablet. The matte black finish blends with contemporary décor, and the sturdy base ensures stability on any desk or tabletop. Ideal for offices, study rooms, or home‑office setups.
